items.brief: Fed proposes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoins, including yield programs
items.why: Establishes federal regulatory framework for stablecoin issuance and operations

items.brief: Fed proposes reserve limits and capital standards for stablecoin issuers
items.why: Sets prudential requirements for entities issuing tokenized deposits and stablecoins

items.brief: Coalition pushes issuer-backed tokenized stocks linked to shareholder records
items.why: Advances tokenization infrastructure for equity securities under SEC framework

items.brief: CFTC allows commodities firms to invest in and use blockchain for tokenized assets
items.why: Regulatory clarity enabling institutional adoption of tokenized commodities

items.brief: SEC clarifies tokenized stock model legitimacy amid market structure debate
items.why: SEC guidance defines which tokenization models meet securities regulations

items.why: Major RWA tokenization: private fund shares moved onchain for broader access

items.brief: UK banks complete interbank tokenized deposit transactions across institutions
items.why: Demonstrates cross-institutional tokenized deposit settlement and payments

items.brief: Stablecoin issuer sees trade finance moving to stablecoins
items.why: Stablecoins enabling transformation of international trade finance infrastructure

items.brief: Ondo launches onchain portfolio tokens using BlackRock model strategies
items.why: RWA tokenization of professionally-managed investment portfolios onchain

items.brief: IBM links Swift ledger for 24/7 tokenized deposit transfers via existing messaging
items.why: Integration of tokenized deposits with legacy banking infrastructure and Swift
